# tosijs-3d v0.2.5

Declarative 3D/XR framework built on Babylon.js and the tosijs web component framework.

- Docs: https://3d.tosijs.net
- Source: https://github.com/tonioloewald/tosijs-3d
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/tosijs-3d

## Documentation

Each component's full documentation (with live code examples) is
embedded in its distributed JS file as inline comments. Read the
relevant dist/*.js file for complete docs, usage examples, and API.

## Components and Utilities

- dist/tosi-b3d.js — b3d
  The root 3D scene container. All other components (`b3dSun`, `b3dSkybox`, `b3dLoader`, etc.)
- dist/b3d-aircraft.js — b3d-aircraft
  Arcade flight controller with optional VTOL. Uses the virtual gamepad input system:
- dist/b3d-biped.js — b3d-biped
  Animated humanoid character controller. Loads a GLB model with skeletal animations
- dist/b3d-black-hole.js — b3d-black-hole
  Procedural black hole with accretion disk, gravitational lensing effect,
- dist/b3d-car.js — b3d-car
  Vehicle controller with acceleration, braking, friction, and speed-dependent steering.
- dist/b3d-collisions.js — b3d-collisions
  Opt-in collision detection via mesh naming conventions authored in Blender.
- dist/b3d-controllable.js — b3d-controllable
  Base class for any entity that can be driven by a `ControlInput` — bipeds, cars,
- dist/b3d-exploder.js — b3d-exploder
  Shatters a mesh into fragments and animates them flying apart. Works by
- dist/b3d-fog.js — b3d-fog
  Adds fog to a scene, useful for atmosphere and hiding distant tile pop-in.
- dist/b3d-galaxy.js — b3d-galaxy
  Procedural galaxy renderer using Babylon.js SolidParticleSystem. Generates
- dist/b3d-input-focus.js — b3d-input-focus
  Focus manager that wires input to the active controllable entity and handles
- dist/b3d-library.js — b3d-library
  Asset library component. Loads a GLB file via `LoadAssetContainer` and holds
- dist/b3d-light.js — b3d-light
  Hemispheric ambient fill light. Wraps `BABYLON.HemisphericLight`. Cheap to render
- dist/b3d-loader.js — b3d-loader
  Loads a GLB/glTF scene file into the 3D scene. Meshes named with `-ignore` are discarded.
- dist/b3d-particles.js — b3d-particles
  Declarative particle effect component wrapping Babylon.js `ParticleSystem`.
- dist/b3d-physics.js — b3d-physics
  Enables Jolt physics on the scene. Add as a child of `<tosi-b3d>` to
- dist/b3d-planet.js — b3d-planet
  Procedural planet mesh using a subdivided cube projected onto a sphere.
- dist/b3d-reflections.js — b3d-reflections
  Auto-attaches a reflection probe to every mesh whose name contains `_mirror`
- dist/b3d-shadows.js — b3d-shadows
  `B3dSun` — directional light + cascaded shadow generator. Add a `<tosi-b3d-sun>`
- dist/b3d-skybox.js — b3d-skybox
  Procedural sky with sun/moon cycle driven by time of day. Automatically controls
- dist/b3d-sound.js — b3d-sound
  Declarative audio component wrapping Babylon.js `Sound`. Supports both
- dist/b3d-star.js — b3d-star
  Procedural star mesh using a subdivided cube projected onto a sphere.
- dist/b3d-star-system.js — b3d-star-system
  Renders an individual star system with a procedural star and its planets.
- dist/b3d-svg-plane.js — b3d-svg-plane
  A plane mesh textured with SVG content. Supports static SVG from a URL or
- dist/b3d-terrain.js — b3d-terrain
  Procedural terrain generator using 3D Perlin noise sampled on a cylinder surface.
- dist/b3d-trigger.js — b3d-trigger
  Invisible proximity zone that fires callbacks and dispatches events when
- dist/b3d-water.js — b3d-water
  Water plane with reflections, waves, and underwater fog effect.
- dist/control-input.js — control-input
  Universal input abstraction for controllable entities. Any entity (biped, car, helicopter, etc.)
- dist/galaxy-data.js — galaxy-data
  Procedural galaxy generation data and functions. Pure logic — no Babylon.js
- dist/game-controller.js — game-controller
  Input component that maps keyboard/mouse to a virtual gamepad and optionally
- dist/gamepad-svg.js — gamepad-svg
  Generates a gamepad SVG using tosijs element creators. All colors and stroke
- dist/glass-gamepad.js — glass-gamepad (b3dGamepad)
  A **split** on-screen ("glass") gamepad for touch contexts, as a Component (so
- dist/hardware-gamepad.js — hardware-gamepad
  Maps a physical gamepad (via `navigator.getGamepads()`) to a `VirtualGamepad`.
- dist/keyboard-gamepad.js — keyboard-gamepad
  Maps keyboard and mouse input to a `VirtualGamepad`. Uses attack/decay smoothing
- dist/b3d-utils.js — Material Conventions
  These conventions apply to all meshes entering the scene — via
- dist/mersenne-twister.js — mersenne-twister
  Seeded pseudo-random number generator based on the Mersenne Twister
- dist/svg-texture.js — svg-texture
  Renders SVG content to a Babylon.js texture via an offscreen canvas.
- dist/touch-gamepad.js — touch-gamepad
  Touch/pointer-driven virtual gamepad backed by an SVG. Elements are identified
- dist/virtual-gamepad.js — virtual-gamepad
  Standardized virtual gamepad abstraction. All input sources (keyboard, hardware gamepad,
- dist/widgets3d.js — widgets3d
  A small collection of **SVG-native** UI widgets with element-creator ergonomics
- dist/widgets3d-layout.js — widgets3d-layout
  Pure layout math for [[widgets3d]] — no tosijs, no DOM, no Babylon, so it is
- dist/world-contract.js — world-contract
  The boundary between the **simulation** (tosijs-3d) and an **external driver**
- dist/world-store.js — world-store
  A pure, Babylon-free, deterministic reference implementation of [[world-contract]].

  The Babylon **view** of a [[world-store]]. The store is the authoritative,
